contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP CAR]AVSIVS PF A[VG] ; R/ SALVS [AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293). Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: [IMP CAR]AVSIVS PF A[VG]. Reverse description: Salus standing left with snake rising to patera in extended right hand, holding vertical sceptre in left hand. Reverse inscription: SALVS [AVG]. Diameter: 19.7mm, Weight: 3.71gms, die axis: 6
